title: 第二十五章   误入风月
content_zh:
没有雨归尘，他们不可能有夺取会稽城的机会。若没有会稽城，雨族就不可能有未来，因为九大镇城从未被外敌攻陷过。

    没有卫起，就不会有现在的雨军，现在的雨国。就算当时夺得会稽城，雨族也只会陷入，与宋人无止境的拉锯战中。

    雨若虚一直都对自己充满了自信，正因为这种自信，他就敢冒大不韪，设计杀死当时的族长，敢拿全族的命做赌注，和雨归尘密谋夺取会稽城。

    他越想越激动，一把将手中的诏书打开。朱红色的大印又一次地提醒他，现在已是阳州的“伯”。

    一阵急促的脚步声从殿外传来，有人直接将门推开，未通报就走了进来。

    在雨国，能够未经通报直接见他，只有雨归尘和卫起两人。雨归尘不会无缘无故来找他，加上现在远在薄州。这风风火火的脚步声，那就只会是卫起。

    雨若虚转过身去，刚才脸上流露出的表情都已消失，恢复成往日庄严的样子。

    “君上。”身穿青衣的卫起走到雨若虚面前。

    雨若虚微微点头示意，从袖中拿出一个包裹递了过去：“这个交给你。”

    卫起瞟了一眼，没有任何表示，也没说要还是不要。

    “给”雨若虚将包裹又往前送了送。

    卫起摇了摇头，表示拒绝。

    “拿着吧。”

    卫起又摇了摇头，“刚有确切消息传来，招摇城与羽人有关，现在封你为伯，估计是要有大战了。”

    雨若虚点了点头：“好好准备一下，要真是这样，估计这个冬天就会发动攻势。”

    卫起点了点头，转身退下。

    “拿着吧。”身后传来雨若虚的声音，卫起并未领会，直接走出大门。

    看着卫起消失的背影，雨若虚看了看手中的包裹。

    “唉。”一声长叹后，就将包裹又收入袖中。

    这本来是他给卫起的最后保障，卫起在雨族这些年，为推行法治，平时杀伐果断，行雷霆手段，虽使法治得以推行，让雨族在最短的时间内得以强大，可刻薄寡恩，树敌无数，最后只怕会是会斧钺加身，难以善终。

    自己将包裹送给他，是想给卫起最后的保障，甚至可以说是将自己的身家性命，都放在他手中，没想到被卫起拒绝。

    雨若虚对着屋顶勾勾手指，一道黑影出现，跪在他面前。

    “没有我的命令，任何人不得打扰。”完全不同于刚才的声音，从雨若虚嘴里发出，显得威严无比，不容置疑。

    “是”话音还未落，黑影就已经消失。

    雨若虚在旁边的长案上，将手中的诏书展开。“受命于天，既寿永昌”的朱红色大印映入眼中。无限的威严，从方正的印记中散发出来，让大印有着不可拒绝的魔力。

    在一股神秘力量的感召下，雨若虚不由自主地伸出手，将手掌放在印章上。

    朱红色的印章蓦地绽放出金色的光芒，诏书上的印章和文字，仿佛被赋予了生命，从沉睡中醒来，不断地扭动纠缠，变化成一条金龙，做引颈长吟状腾空而起，对着雨若虚的脑门冲去。

    一阵耀眼的光芒，彻底将整个大殿照得透亮。

    一条条信息，传入雨若虚的大脑。此时的他好像飞在了空中，俯视着整个会稽城，可在他眼中，除了大街小巷，城墙楼阁外，还多了一条条交织纵横五色的气流。

    这些参差交错的五彩气流，最后全部都流向城中高台上的巨鼎。

    所有镇城中央的高台上，都会有一个这样的鼎。

    禹皇划九州，故曰“九鼎”。
content_en:
Without Yu Guichen, they would not have had a chance to capture Kuaiji City. Without Kuaiji City, the Yu clan would not have a future, because the nine major towns have never been captured by foreign enemies.

    Without Wei Qi, there would not be the current Yujun and the current Yuguo. Even if they captured Kuaiji City at that time, the Yu clan would only be trapped in an endless tug-of-war with the Song people.

    Yu Ruoxu has always been full of confidence in himself. Because of this confidence, he dared to take risks, planned to kill the clan leader at that time, dared to bet the lives of the entire clan, and conspired with Yu Guichen to seize Kuaiji City.

    The more he thought about it, the more excited he became, and he opened the edict in his hand. The large scarlet seal reminded him once again that he was now the "uncle" of Yangzhou.

    A rush of footsteps came from outside the hall. Someone pushed the door open and walked in without announcing.

    In Yu Country, only two people, Yu Guichen and Wei Qi, could see him directly without notification. Yu Guichen would not come to him for no reason, and he was far away in Bozhou now. The sound of these turbulent footsteps could only be that of Wei Qi.

    Yu Ruoxu turned around, the expression on his face just now disappeared and returned to his usual solemn look.

    "Your Majesty." Wei Qi, who was wearing green clothes, walked up to Yu Ruoxu.

    Yu Ruoxu nodded slightly, took out a package from his sleeve and handed it over: "I'll leave this to you."

    Wei Qi glanced at it, but didn't say anything, and didn't say whether he wanted it or not.

    "Here" Yu Ruoxu sent the package forward again.

    Wei Qi shook his head and refused.

    "Take it."

    Wei Qi shook his head again, "There has just been confirmed news that Zhaoyao City is related to the Yuren. Now that you are made uncle, there will probably be a war."

    Yu Ruoxu nodded: "Be well prepared. If this is the case, we will probably launch an offensive this winter."

    Wei nodded, turned around and left.

    "Take it." Yu Ruoxu's voice came from behind. Wei Qi didn't understand it and walked out of the door directly.

    Looking at Wei Qi's disappearing figure, Yu Ruoxu looked at the package in his hand.

    "Alas." After a long sigh, he put the package back into his sleeve.

    This was originally his last guarantee for Wei Qi. In order to enforce the rule of law in the Yu Clan over the years, Wei Qi usually killed decisively and used thunderous methods. Although the rule of law was implemented and the Yu Clan became strong in the shortest time, he was mean and ungrateful and made countless enemies. In the end, he was afraid that he would be attacked with axes and axes, and it would be difficult to end well.

    I gave the package to him because I wanted to give Wei Qi the final guarantee. It could even be said that I was putting my life and property in his hands, but I didn't expect Wei Qi to reject it.

    Yu Ruoxu raised his fingers towards the roof, and a black shadow appeared and knelt in front of him.

    "No one is allowed to disturb you without my order." It was completely different from the voice just now. It came from Yu Ruoxu's mouth and seemed extremely majestic and unquestionable.

    "Yes" Before the words could be heard, the black shadow had disappeared.

    Yu Ruoxu unfolded the edict in his hand on the long table next to him. The large vermilion seal of "If you are ordered by heaven, you will live forever" comes into view. Infinite majesty emanates from the Founder's mark, giving the seal an irresistible magical power.

    Inspired by a mysterious force, Yu Ruoxu involuntarily stretched out his hand and placed his palm on the seal.

    The scarlet seal suddenly burst into golden light, and the seal and words on the edict seemed to be given life. They woke up from their deep sleep, kept twisting and entangled, and transformed into a golden dragon. It rose into the sky with a long groan and rushed toward Yu Ruoxu's head.

    A burst of dazzling light completely illuminated the entire hall.

    One piece of information was passed into Yu Ruoxu's brain. At this time, he seemed to be flying in the air, overlooking the entire Kuaiji City, but in his eyes, in addition to the streets, alleys, city walls and pavilions, there were also intertwining air currents of five colors.

    These staggered and colorful air currents all flowed towards the giant cauldron on the high platform in the city.

    There will be a tripod like this on the high platform in the center of every town.

    Emperor Yu divided the nine states, hence the name "Jiuding".
